_note: Synthetic service bulletins for a demo. Titles, fixes and part numbers are invented.

bulletins.title: Cell group balance drift on early battery packs
bulletins.fix: Replace the affected battery module and rebalance the pack.

bulletins.title: Inverter phase current sensor offset
symptoms: motor cuts out and restarts at full throttle
bulletins.fix: Replace the inverter current sensor board and run the phase calibration.

bulletins.title: Coolant pump connector corrosion
bulletins.fix: Replace the coolant pump and its sealed connector, bleed the loop.

bulletins.title: Charge port seal and washing guidance
bulletins.fix: Dry the charge port, replace the port seal. Pressure washing at the charge port is excluded by the owner manual.

bulletins.title: Throttle connector retention clip
symptoms: throttle cuts in and out over bumps
bulletins.fix: Fit the new retention clip and reseat the throttle connector.

bulletins.title: Charge stops at 80 percent on firmware before 4.1.0
symptoms: charge power drops to zero at 80 percent
bulletins.fix: Update the battery controller and vehicle controller firmware to 4.1.0 or later. No parts.

bulletins.title: Display harness routing on supermoto fork
bulletins.fix: Reroute the display harness away from the fork stop.

bulletins.title: Isolation monitor false alarms in heavy rain
bulletins.fix: Update isolation monitor thresholds with firmware 4.1.2.

bulletins.title: Motor encoder connector strain relief
bulletins.fix: Fit strain relief to the encoder connector.
